stores.name: Star Buds Dispensary Medical Weed Lawton
about: Welcome to Star Buds Weed Dispensary in Lawton Oklahoma! We are conveniently located on NW Cache Rd just a quarter mile west of Sheridan Rd. We maintain a large inventory of cannabis flower, edibles, extracts, concentrates, tinctures, topicals, and more! We seek to have a selection of products for everyone whether you are a first time user or a seasoned cannabis consumer.
Looking for extra speed and convenience? Skip the line and place your order online to pick up in store!

Star Buds Lawton Medical Weed Dispensary is proud to serve cannabis consumers in Comanche County to include the communities of Cache, Chattanooga, Elgin, Faxon, Fort Sill, Frederick, Indiahoma, Lawton, Manitou Medicine Park, Meers, Mountain Park, Roosevelt, Snyder, Walters and the surrounding areas.

visit.q: This is my first time visiting Star Buds. What should I bring with me?
visit.a: All visitors must be at least 18 years of age with a valid medical card and must provide a valid photo ID. We take cash and debit cards and there is also an ATM inside our dispensary for your convenience.
We understand that normal operating hours are not always convenient for our consumers with busy lifestyles, which is why our dispensary is open Monday through Sunday from 8:00 am to 12:00 am.

visit.q: Does Star Buds offer any discounts or ways to save on orders?
visit.a: We run product specials seven days a week, and our loyalty rewards program offers even more savings. We are happy to provide our MED card holders and veterans with a discount upon request.

photo.alt: Inside Star Buds Lawton: glass display cases of jarred flower

rewards.title: Higher Rewards
rewards.nameNote: The main site calls it "Higher Rewards Loyalty Program" (rewards.json, hr-tc.json); the sister storefront nav calls it "Higher Rewards".
paragraphs: Join our Higher Rewards Loyalty Program and get rewarded when you visit the store! Simply present your custom rewards wallet on each visit and automatically earn points towards discounts and specials on your favorite products. Best of all, it’s absolutely FREE!
points: Customers will accrue one (1) loyalty point (each, a “Point”) for every $1 spent on the total qualifying purchase of both cannabis and non-cannabis products (not including discounts, returns, credits, delivery fees, and taxes).
To redeem an offer or reward, Customers must let the budtender know that they are a Program member and that they wish to redeem their points or award at the time of the qualifying transaction.

about.title: The Star Buds Difference
paragraphs: Star Buds is your neighborhood dispensary. We provide a comfortable setting to learn about and purchase all types of cannabis products. Our carefully curated selection includes: flower, concentrates, edibles and topicals. We have something for everyone… from the occasional smoker to the daily consumer. We strive to educate customers, normalize usage and contribute to our local communities.

Community is at the heart of everything we do. Through our Cancer Relief Program, we extend discounted access to cannabis products to those in need. We're also dedicated to honoring our veterans, providing ongoing discounts, and continuously seeking ways to make a positive impact in our communities.
